cases.requirement: Every human and machine projection resolves to stable graph identifiers and source references.
cases.failure: A route contains an unsupported copy-only claim or an entity with no canonical source node.

cases.requirement: Repository, company, evidence, connector, route, and release sets are loaded from timestamped snapshots rather than fixed application arrays.
cases.failure: A mutable inventory is treated as a permanent complete list.

cases.requirement: Cross-links declare a typed relationship and preserve backlinks or equivalent reverse navigation.
cases.failure: A visual or navigation relationship has no machine-readable edge.

cases.requirement: Every graph projection has a searchable table or adjacency-list representation containing the same nodes, edge types, states, and source links.
cases.failure: Meaning exists only in canvas, SVG geometry, hover state, or color.

cases.requirement: Every chart exposes source data, units, scope, and a table fallback.
cases.failure: A chart implies precision or quantity not present in the source.

cases.requirement: Each motion sequence declares state, causality, spatial relationship, or focus-transition purpose.
cases.failure: Motion exists only for spectacle or obscures evidence.

cases.requirement: All animated explanations remain complete with reduced motion enabled and with client scripting unavailable.
cases.failure: A user loses sequence, state, or navigation meaning when motion is reduced.

cases.requirement: Filters, selected nodes, comparison states, and guided-tour positions are reconstructable from stable route state.
cases.failure: An important view cannot be deep-linked, restored, or audited.

cases.requirement: Dense graphs, matrices, timelines, and comparisons transform into usable compact representations without dropping evidence labels.
cases.failure: Mobile behavior is horizontal shrinkage, clipping, or hidden proof.

cases.requirement: Public-surface validation follows generated routes, backlinks, graph edges, search records, and machine APIs to detect sensitive exposure.
cases.failure: A private node becomes reachable through secondary navigation or generated data.

cases.requirement: Every moving-target projection exposes observation time, source revision, scope, and stale state.
cases.failure: A snapshot appears current or complete after its freshness rule expires.

cases.requirement: Size, placement, animation, color, ranking, or narrative order cannot raise an entity above its recorded evidence and promotion state.
cases.failure: Presentation makes a candidate, blocked, reference-only, or stale system appear verified.

cases.requirement: Every client-side capability declares benefit, data input, privacy impact, performance budget, accessibility behavior, fallback, tests, and removal path.
cases.failure: A script is admitted because it is visually impressive or framework-conventional.

cases.requirement: The live site can be rebuilt from the recorded source revision, snapshot set, policy overlay, and artifact manifest.
cases.failure: Production contains untracked patches, stale generated data, or unverifiable assets.
